guides.title: Sony cameras: record, REC, settings, time code, live view, phone remote
guides.text: Four different things are called 'record the Sony', and each has its own app. Recording the picture to the Mac disk is Webcam Recorder (web-cam-viewer, port 8867); starting REC on the camera's own card is Sony Remote (SONY_REMOTE_MAC, port 8881) or, through Imaging Edge Remote and Accessibility, `sonycam` in MACRO_SKILLS. Only one program can hold the camera's USB at a time (Imaging Edge Remote locks it, so Webcam Recorder asks for TAKE CONTROL), and a camera streaming over USB (UVC) cannot also be controlled over that cable. ISO and shutter through Webcam Recorder (`/sony/set`) are written in the code but were not verified against a real body at v27. Time code jam and Bluetooth REC for several Sonys are the Android app, not the Mac apps.

stop that recording and get the file path
start REC on the camera's own card from the Mac

guides.title: Allen & Heath CQ-12T mixer (nine apps)
guides.text: CQ MixPad (Mantra) is the Android remote built on the desk's decoded private protocol (TCP 51326); the protocol facts are in the public cq_mixpad_protocol, which also has the sniffer and injector. The desk allows one client at a time. To use it from a phone over a USB-LAN cable see CQ_ETHERNET_BRIDGE (a recipe, no code). From a knob controller use the OXI-CQ Bridge (oxi_e16_cq-12t, HTTP on 8753, MIDI NRPN, not the private protocol). The rest are a tutorial, a mount adapter, the Mac audio-output preference and the Ableton channel macros.

guides.title: Transcription (speech to text): Mac, Android, Termux, web, Croatian
guides.text: Mac: dictation is Vox to Txt (MANTRA_VOICE_TO_TEXT, F1 hotkey, language en, hr or auto, port 8865 for files); a YouTube link or file goes through `scribe` (MAC_TRANSCRIBER). Android: TTT is the voice keyboard (English and Croatian engines); MAHA_TRANSCRIBE_ANDROID_2 is the native app, version 1 only the Talk to Type screen; TATA_Talk is a simple Croatian-only app in a private repo. Termux: `transcribe` (MAHA_TRANSCRIBE_TERMUX_TERMINAL) serves the page. Web and servers: the Streamlit and Flask Maha Transcribe pages (Whisper on Groq, language hint hr), 111/222 Transcribe (AssemblyAI with speakers and subtitles) and the hosted TTT Portal API. MARKO_TRANSCRIBE, MAHA_TRANSCRIBE_TERMUX and the web-view MAHA_TRANSCRIBE_ANDROID are superseded.

guides.title: Read aloud / text to speech: Mac, Android, Termux, engines
guides.text: On the Mac, speaking and reading are one server: Mantra Voice (MANTRA_VOICE, port 8837) with `/speak` for a spoken line and `/say` for mp3 plus word timings; VOICE_ENGINE is only the subtitle band and the global on/off switch. On the phone, `phonesay` and TERMUX_VOICE (port 8840) speak a line; the browser reader with the word lit is MA_READER_TERMUX_MACOS (Termux or Mac, Edge and Speechify voices, port 8081). The native Android app MA Reader (MA_READER_ANDROID) does not speak yet; its engine is the Kotlin library MA_READER_ENGINE (Edge speech with word timing) that TTT's LLL reader also uses. Google voices are GOOGLE_TTS_STT (gtt, 7311) and GoogleVoices (gvoice, 8300).

guides.title: Voice dictation keyboard
guides.text: On Android the voice keyboard is TTT (Talk to Type, repo TTT; package seen as tttlight): dictate into any text field with cloud or offline engines, with an RE reply assistant and an adb remote API. DictateKeyboard (TTT&LLL) is the older fork with the AI reader (LLL) and is dormant; ttt-layouts restores the owner's key layout. On the Mac and Windows the equivalent is Vox to Txt (MANTRA_VOICE_TO_TEXT): press F1, talk, press F1, the words are typed at the cursor.

guides.title: Keyboard lights and visuals
guides.text: The only light hardware with an API today is the Logitech G815 keyboard, run by G815 Lights (G815_LIGHTS, HTTP 8877, stream 8878): it is a 115-key low-resolution LED display for any app's pictures or shows. Mantra Room (MANTRA_ROOM) drives it with `lights: true` in `play-loop` and has the MilkDrop visuals. There is no app for Bluetooth LED lights (Neewer) yet; Light Control is planned (see gaps).

picks.for: show a colour or picture on the keyboard

guides.title: Controlling a Mac app that has no API (Accessibility, macros, Star API)
guides.text: Macro Recorder (MANTRA_MACRO) holds the Accessibility and screen permissions for all other apps. `macro ax-read "<app>"` lists a running app's buttons and `macro ax-press "<app>" "<label>"` presses one by its title (exact, then prefix, then part), in any running app. Ask MACRO_SKILLS first whether a macro already exists (`macroskill has`), play stored ones with `macro run "<name>"`, and fall back to OCR or picture search (`macro click-text`) when the tree has nothing. Star API (STAR_API, 8863) does the same for the Mantra star apps over HTTP (`star press "timer" "stopwatch"`), and apps may also register real functions with `star fn`. Never use synthetic key presses where the tree works.

picks.for: press a button in any Mac app by its label

guides.title: Controlling Claude Code sessions: phone, Mac, cloud
guides.text: Phone: AGENT_MANAGER_ANDROID is the client of the Mac's AGENT_MANAGER phone door (8847, bearer token over Tailscale), where blockers are answered and tasks paused; CLAUDE_CODE_TERMUX installs Claude Code on the phone itself. Mac: SESSION_HUB (8890) and SESSION_ACK (8899) pass messages between sessions, CCMC (MANTRA CHAT, 8825) mirrors a session as a chat page, TALK_MODE talks to sessions by voice, CLAUDE_CONTROL (`claudectl pause`) stops everything Claude runs, COST_AGENT asks before paid calls. Cloud: vm-chromium drives claude.ai in a VM browser (`cvm ask`). CLAUDE_CODE_MONITOR is archived.

guides.title: Cloud VMs: Android emulator and Chromium
guides.text: Two Oracle Cloud machines are reached over Tailscale. vm-android is a redroid Pixel 7 with the Mac command `pixel7` and the door pixel7d on 8897; vm-android-jobs is the git mailbox for the same phone: push `jobs/<id>/job.json` and an APK, pull `results/<id>/result.json`. vm-chromium is the Chromium VM with the vm-agent on 8890 and the Mac command `cvm`. Local, not cloud: MANTRA_SANDBOX runs a headless emulator on the Mac. Related VM services: CLOUD_MIXER and STREAMING_DASHBOARD.

guides.title: DaVinci Resolve
guides.text: Anything that must run Resolve's scripting API goes through the router in DaVinci Resolve Actions (DAVINCI_RESOLVE_ACTIONS, port 8940, `POST /run`): never open a second connection. The command-line `resolve.py` in ABLETON_TEACHER (`python3 resolve.py marker 250 Red "look here"`) is a second route for markers, timelines and render. RESOLVE_PAGES, UHD_HD_DISPLAY and IMPORT_BUTTON are small Mac helpers; DaVinci Teacher (MANTRA_TEACHERS, 8971) teaches Resolve step by step. DAVINCI_RESOLVE_ASSISTANT is superseded by DAVINCI_RESOLVE_ACTIONS.

guides.title: Ableton Live
guides.text: Ableton is driven by AbletonOSC (UDP 11000 in, 11001 answers; 11001 has one owner and others send to the router on 11002). ABLETON_LIVE_ACTIONS is the Mac app with the A1 assistant, MIDI to Mackie and CQ channel macros; `python3 live.py set /live/song/set/tempo 96` in ABLETON_TEACHER is the quickest scripted call; Queen exposes `POST /api/ableton/action` and mantra_pages `POST /api/live`. ABLETON_COMMAND_GUIDE answers shortcut questions by voice; the Teacher apps (MANTRA_TEACHERS, 8970) teach step by step.

picks.for: use a MIDI knob as a Mackie control in Live

guides.title: Ports and the door protocol: how any app is called
guides.text: A Mantra Mac app listens on 127.0.0.1 only, on a port it claims by name in MANTRA_PORTS (registry file ~/.config/mantra-ports.json), and answers `GET /health`, `GET /api` (the declared actions) and `POST /api/<action>` with a JSON body; the reply is `{ok, result}` or `{ok:false, error}`. Mantra Door is the token-guarded gateway for the phone (header X-Mantra-Token, token in ~/.config/mantra-door.token, Tailscale address only): `GET /apps`, `POST /apps/<id>/launch`, and any `/apps/<id>/api/...` is passed on to the app, starting it if needed. Python code uses `mantra_remote.py` (`remote.call("dock-switcher", "show")`). To give a NEW app a port run `mantra-ports next`, claim it at start with `ports.claim("my-app", N)` (Swift `Ports.claim`, Lua `ports.lua`) and ask by name everywhere else. Several numbers are claimed twice, notably 8965 (MANTRA_ROOM, MPA_LESSONS_ANALYZER, SECOND_TAKE_REMOTE), 8837 (MANTRA_VOICE, VOICE_ENGINE) and 8847 (AGENT_MANAGER, retired spotlight): check which app answers `GET /health`.

picks.for: get a free port for a new app and register it

picks.how: import sys, os; sys.path.insert(0, os.path.expanduser('~/.local/lib/mantra')); import ports; PORT = ports.claim('my-app', 8962)

guides.title: OXI E16 and MIDI controllers
guides.text: The OXI E16 is used three ways: as a remote for Ableton Live or DaVinci Resolve audio (oxi-controller, UDP test door on 11010), as a controller of the CQ-12T mixer (oxi_e16_cq-12t, HTTP 8753, MIDI NRPN), and as Mackie Control under Ableton's timeline (mantra-mackie-control-translator, Hammerspoon). Generic MIDI helpers: MIDI Tools (MANTRA_MIDI_TOOLS), Controller Mapper for any USB controller (mix-ultra-mapper) and the dormant MIDI to Key Stroke (MIDI_TO_KEYSTROKE) and Mantra Controls.

guides.title: Maps, location, transit
guides.text: Offline maps: Mantra Map Server (MANTRA_MAP_SERVER, 8088) serves mapsforge maps as z/x/y PNG tiles from a phone; MANTRA_MAPS holds the map files; Mantra Trail (MANTRA_TRAIL) is the Android outdoor map for Croatian mountains. Croatian cadastral parcels: ARKOD (mantra_arkod Android, arkod_web PWA). Everyday finders: SHOP_FINDER (shops and pools), spar_locator, Maha Commute (MAHA_COMMUTE, Zagreb and Rijeka transit) and ZET Strike (zet_strike, 8100).

gaps.note: No app generates or plays a gong or bowl. Closest: MANTRA_ROOM plays any track in a loop and has a soft bell for its session timer; SHRUTI_BOX_AND_VOICE_TRAINER is a drone and raga box, not a gong.

Light Control (Mantra), also called Mantra Neewer, is planned: a Mac app for the Neewer light over Bluetooth LE with a local HTTP API (kickoff prompt prompts/LIGHT_CONTROL.md). Nothing in the map controls Bluetooth LED lights; the only light API is the G815 keyboard.

Planned in the same prompt: Mantra Room listens to the room microphone so MilkDrop follows an ambient sound such as a gong, and the colours drive the lights slowly. MANTRA_ROOM has MilkDrop visuals but no microphone input today.
